samandhakāra.p: [ saṃ + andhakāra. Samandhakāra-saṃ. ] (pu) Google Translate (night) darkness darkness"

P: Samandhakāra，[saṁ+andhakāra] the dark of night Vin．IV，54； DhA．II，94； S．III，60．（Page 683）
R:
samandhakāra：သမန္ဓကာရ （ပ） （သံ+အန္ဓကာရ）
အမိုက်တိုက်။

sāmaṇḍaka.p: [ saha + āmaṇḍa + ka. Saṃ + maṇḍaka?. Īpudamyiuḥ sakkata, pākata, dhānatiu့၌ marhi. Sāmaṇḍakāni?. ] (pu) Google Translate What kind of person is Samantha?
pn: Sāmaṇḍaka, Sāmaṇḍakāni, Sāmañcakāni. A Paribbājaka, mentioned (SN.iv.261f) as having visited Sāriputta at Ukkācelā (Ukkāvelā) and questioned him regarding Nibbāna, and again (AN.v.121f) at Nālakagāma, where he questioned him regarding weal and woe. He is, perhaps, to be identified with Sāmaññakāni.

sāmaṇḍakasaṃyutta.p: [ sāmaṇḍaka + saṃyutta ] (na) Google Translate Samantha is weak.

sāmaṇḍakāni.p: [ sāmaṇḍaka + ṇāna=sāmaṇḍakāna + ṇi. Sāmaññakāni-pudakaဲ့siu့. ] (pu) Google Translate The son of a man named Thamankanana.

R:
samaṇḍalīkata：သ-မဏ္ဍလီ-ကတ （တိ）
အနားပတ် ပြုအပ်သည်။ အိမ်ကြီးအိမ်ငယ်နှင့်တကွ ဖြစ်သည်။
